entries.title: Psalms 24:1
segments: <<A Psalm of David.>> The earth is Jehovah's, and the fulness thereof; The world, and they that dwell therein.

entries.title: Psalms 24:2
segments: For he hath founded it upon the seas, And established it upon the floods.

entries.title: Psalms 24:3
segments: Who shall ascend into the hill of Jehovah? And who shall stand in his holy place?

entries.title: Psalms 24:4
segments: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; Who hath not lifted up his soul unto falsehood, And hath not sworn deceitfully.

entries.title: Psalms 24:5
segments: He shall receive a blessing from Jehovah, And righteousness from the God of his salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 24:6
segments: This is the generation of them that seek after him, That seek thy face, [even] Jacob. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 24:7
segments: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; And be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors: And the King of glory will come in.

entries.title: Psalms 24:8
segments: Who is the King of glory? Jehovah strong and mighty, Jehovah mighty in battle.

entries.title: Psalms 24:9
segments: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; Yea, lift them up, ye everlasting doors: And the King of glory will come in.

entries.title: Psalms 24:10
segments: Who is this King of glory? Jehovah of hosts, He is the King of glory. Selah
